problem: Laptop becomes very hot and may suddenly shut down during gaming, heavy applications, or prolonged use.
diagnostic_clues: Fan becomes unusually loud
Laptop shuts down when under heavy load
Device becomes hot around the keyboard or exhaust vents
repair_guidance: Clean the ventilation system and check the cooling fan. If temperatures remain high, professional servicing and thermal paste replacement may be required.
safety: Do not open or service the laptop while it is powered on.

problem: Laptop does not charge, charges intermittently, or only works when the charger is connected.
diagnostic_clues: Charging indicator does not appear
Battery percentage does not increase
Laptop turns off when the charger is removed
repair_guidance: Check the charger and charging port first. If the adapter is working correctly, the battery or charging circuit may require professional diagnosis.
safety: Do not attempt electrical repairs without appropriate experience.

problem: Phone battery drains unusually quickly even with normal usage.
diagnostic_clues: Battery percentage drops rapidly
Phone becomes warm during normal use
Battery life has become significantly shorter over time
repair_guidance: Check battery usage statistics and background applications. If the battery has degraded significantly, replacement may be appropriate.
safety: Do not puncture, bend, or physically damage the battery.

problem: Phone does not charge or charging repeatedly connects and disconnects.
possible_causes: Dust or debris in charging port
diagnostic_clues: Charging starts and stops repeatedly
Cable only works at a certain angle
No charging indicator appears
repair_guidance: Try a known-good charger and cable. Inspect the charging port for visible debris. If the problem continues, professional inspection is recommended.
safety: Do not insert sharp metal objects into the charging port.

problem: Electric fan does not start, rotates slowly, or stops unexpectedly.
diagnostic_clues: Fan hums but does not rotate
Fan rotates slowly
Fan stops after running for some time
repair_guidance: The problem may involve the capacitor, motor, wiring, or mechanical components. Professional electrical inspection is recommended.
safety: Disconnect the fan from mains power before any inspection.

problem: Washing machine completes washing but does not drain the water.
diagnostic_clues: Water remains inside the drum
Machine makes unusual sounds during draining
Drain cycle takes unusually long
repair_guidance: Check the drain hose and accessible filter for blockage. If the pump does not operate correctly, professional repair may be required.
safety: Disconnect the appliance from power before inspecting accessible components.

problem: Refrigerator is running but is not cooling food properly.
diagnostic_clues: Interior temperature is higher than normal
Compressor runs continuously
Freezer or refrigerator compartment is not reaching normal temperature
repair_guidance: Check airflow and accessible ventilation areas. Compressor, refrigerant, and sealed-system problems require professional service.
safety: Do not attempt to handle refrigerant yourself.
